# User signed out (`logoff`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Computer & sign-in · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

Fires when a user signs out.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | user or list of users | no |  | Only fire when one of these users signs out. Accepts a user name (samet), DOMAIN\name, a SID, or wildcards (admin*). Leave empty for any user. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: logoff
    user: samet
```

## Notes

Actions that take a long time may be cut short because Windows is closing the session.
